descriptionHero: We introduce the Regeneration Credit, a funding mechanism for environmental service and a smart contract certification system.
descWhatIsIt: The Regeneration Credit is a payment for environmental service system. Users can regenerate to earn the tokens and trade it for a certificate.
descCardPublicData: Every data in the system is public and transparent to everyone
descCardSmartContracts: The RC is a set of smart contracts that define the rules of the system without a trusted central authority.

community.title: Community
community.description: Seven complementary roles keep the protocol running, from field regeneration to verification, research, development and funding.
community.descRegenerators: Core users providing terrestrial ecosystem regeneration services by registering and managing a regeneration area.
community.descInspectors: Responsible for decentralized data collection and verification of Regenerators' activities, such as counting trees and assessing biodiversity.
community.descResearchers: Responsible for environmental research, developing evaluation methodologies, and creating impact calculator items.
community.descDevelopers: Responsible for the technical development of the system, including smart contracts, front-end interfaces, and related applications.
community.descContributors: A generic contribution user who can provide community support, translations, design, and any other general functions that benefit the project.
community.descActivists: Empowered to invite new Regenerators and Inspectors into the system, expanding the community's reach.
community.descSupporters: Any individual or organization, who can finance regeneration by purchasing tokens from users and then burning them to receive an offset certificate.

technologyLead: The protocol is a set of smart contracts. No company in the middle, no trusted authority.
openSourceDesc: Every contract and interface is public and built by the community.
publicDataDesc: Regenerators, inspections and impact all live on-chain, readable by anyone.
auditedDesc: The 22 core contracts were audited by Nethermind Security before mainnet.
step1Desc: Register a regeneration area and bring it back to life, planting and protecting the ecosystem.
step2Desc: Inspectors visit the area and record its trees and species in a peer-to-peer verification.
step3Desc: Verified impact is converted into Regeneration Credit, which supporters buy and retire for a certificate.
investDesc: Back the regeneration of ecosystems by holding Regeneration Credit and retiring it for a contribution certificate.
invest1Desc: Buy directly from a community member to hold a balance of the asset.
invest2Title: Use it as a medium of exchange
invest2Desc: Transfer it freely and use it to trade.
invest3Desc: Retire your credits to receive a contribution certificate.
